The issuer shows only neutral liquidity (current ratio ~1.00) and significant accumulated losses (retained earnings of -6,947M), which weakens credit resilience. However, profitability is relatively solid (EBIT 283M on revenue 1,635M) and leverage is not extreme given shareholders’ equity of 23,369M versus total liabilities of 23,463M, supporting a sub-investment-grade but not highly distressed rating.  

DECISION: BB-
